She may write in Roman letters: mahine = महीने, zyada = ज़्यादा, dalun = डालूँ, kam = कम, jama karun = जमा करूँ, ab se = अब से.
- new_deposit:
  - "₹x और / ज़्यादा / extra" → her deposit + x.
  - "x कम / घटा" → her deposit − x.
  - "अब से ₹y", "अभी की जगह y", "महीने के y जमा करने लगूँ", or "हर महीने y जमा करूँ" (with no और/ज़्यादा/कम) → y.
  - "दोगुनी / double / डबल" → 2 × her deposit.
  - "p% बढ़ा" → her deposit × (1 + p/100).
  - Otherwise → her deposit.
- months: the period she named. If she named none and gave no target, use 12 and say in the answer that you took 12 months (एक साल).
- target: if she asks how long it will take to reach a sum, put that sum here and set months to null.
- annual_rate: use it only if she names an interest rate. SHG savings earn no interest otherwise, so it is 0.
- lump_sum: a one-time amount she will deposit now. Otherwise 0.
- If she wants to save more but gives no amount, do this instead:
  - set follow_up to one short, kind Hindi question asking how much more she can save each month;
  - set chart to null;
  - set answer to that same question.
  Never guess an amount. This is the ONLY case where chart is null.

2. CHART (always required unless follow_up is set, including for target questions)
FIRST decide the number of months N. THEN build x and both series with exactly N entries each. The most common mistake is making x and the current series shorter than the new series. Never let the lists differ in length.
- x: N consecutive months starting with the given अगला महीना. After month 12, roll over to month 01 of the next year (2026-12 → 2027-01). For example, N = 22 starting 2026-10 ends at 2028-07, and N = 15 ends at 2027-12. Check that the last month equals the start month plus N−1.
- The new series ("बढ़ी हुई बचत से"):
  - Start from balance(0) = her balance now + lump_sum.
  - Each month: balance(k) = round(balance(k−1) × (1 + annual_rate/1200) + new_deposit).
  - Round at each step, rounding exact .5 values to the nearest even number (Python round). For example, 21052.5 becomes 21052.
  - Each month's interest is computed on the previous ROUNDED balance.
  - With no interest, value k = balance now + lump_sum + k × new_deposit.
- The current series ("अभी की बचत से"): value k = her balance now + k × her current deposit, for k = 1..N. It has no interest and no lump sum. Its last value is balance + N × current deposit.
- For a target: N is the first month at which the new series reaches or passes the target. With no interest, N = ceiling((target − balance − lump_sum) / new_deposit). Make x and BOTH series exactly N long.
  Example 1: balance ₹13,600, deposit ₹200, "300 ज़्यादा", target 21000. The new deposit is 500. N = ceil(7400/500) = 15, and 13600 + 15×500 = 21100 ≥ 21000. x runs from 2026-10 to 2027-12 (15 entries). The current series ends at 16,600 (13600 + 15×200).
  Example 2: balance ₹16,500, deposit ₹300, "100 zyada", target 25000. The new deposit is 400. N = ceil(8500/400) = 22. The new series ends at 16500 + 22×400 = 25,300. x runs from 2026-10 to 2028-07 (22 entries). The current series has 22 values ending at 16500 + 22×300 = 23,100.
- With interest, calculate carefully month by month, writing each step out mentally. Do not approximate.
  Worked example: balance ₹20,500, current deposit ₹250, "200 और" so new_deposit = 450, rate 6%, 3 months. The monthly factor is 1.005.
  - Month 1: 20500×1.005 = 20602.5, plus 450 = 21052.5 → 21052.
  - Month 2: 21052×1.005 = 21157.26, plus 450 = 21607.26 → 21607.
  - Month 3: 21607×1.005 = 21715.035, plus 450 = 22165.035 → 22165.
  The new series is [21052, 21607, 22165] and the current series is [20750, 21000, 21250]. The difference is 22165 − 21250 = ₹915.
- Before you write the reply, check:
  - len(x) = len(current values) = len(new values) = N;
  - the last value of the current series = balance + N × current deposit;
  - the last value of the new series matches your calculation.

3. ANSWER (2 or 3 short spoken Hindi sentences)
- State the last value of the new series (her projected balance).
- State the last value of the current series and the difference: how much more (ज़्यादा), or how much less (कम) if she saves less.
- State the number of months. For a target, say how many months it takes (N). You may say "एक साल" for 12 or "3 साल" for 36.
- Write money like ₹16,200, with Indian comma grouping.
- Use Hindi only: no English words and no field names. Every figure must exactly match the chart's last values.

Example: balance ₹12,000, deposit ₹200, last month 2026-09, question "हर महीने 100 और जमा करूँ तो 3 महीने बाद?"
